# Spec: Write Step — v2

---

## Overview

**File**: `lib/write.sh`
**Input**: Generated files from `.claude/harness/rules/`, `.claude/harness/.map-content.tmp`, `config.json`
**Output**: `CLAUDE.md` (map), `.claude/settings.json` (hooks), Zone B templates
**Executor**: Pure shell script (no LLM)

### v2 Changes Summary

| v1 | v2 |
|---|---|
| Concatenate `generated/*.md` into single block | Assemble map (~20 lines) from template |
| `HARNESS:START` marker | `HARNESS:START v2` marker |
| `state.json` tracks managed hooks | `config.json` tracks managed hooks |
| No Zone B | Write Zone B templates (state/, plans/) |
| `generated/` directory for assembled content | `rules/` directory — files stay separate, read on-demand |

---

## CLAUDE.md Marker System — v2

### Format

```markdown
<!-- HARNESS:START v2 — Auto-generated by harness-toolkit v{version}. Do not edit. -->

{map content — ~20 lines}

<!-- HARNESS:END v2 -->
```

### Rules

1. **Single marker pair only** — exactly one `HARNESS:START v2` and one `HARNESS:END v2` per file
2. **Markers at top of file** — map always comes first
3. **Everything outside markers is untouchable** — toolkit never reads, modifies, or deletes content outside markers
4. **Version in markers** — `v2` distinguishes from v1 format
5. **Scoped files use same pattern** — `src/payments/CLAUDE.md` has its own START/END v2 pair

### Write behaviors

| Scenario | Behavior |
|---|---|
| CLAUDE.md doesn't exist | Create new file with marker block only |
| CLAUDE.md exists, no markers | Prepend marker block before existing content |
| CLAUDE.md exists, has v2 markers | Replace content between v2 markers, preserve rest |
| CLAUDE.md exists, has v1 markers | Migrate: replace v1 markers with v2 markers + map content |
| Markers are malformed | Abort write, report error, don't touch file |

---

## Write Operations

### 1. Write CLAUDE.md Map

```bash
write_claude_md() {
  local map_file="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/harness/.map-content.tmp"
  local target="$PROJECT_ROOT/CLAUDE.md"
  local version="$TOOLKIT_VERSION"

  if [ ! -f "$map_file" ]; then
    log_error "Map content not found. Run generate first."
    return 4
  fi

  local map_content="$(cat "$map_file")"
  local marker_start="<!-- HARNESS:START v2 — Auto-generated by harness-toolkit v${version}. Do not edit. -->"
  local marker_end="<!-- HARNESS:END v2 -->"
  local full_block="$marker_start
$map_content
$marker_end"

  if [ "$HARNESS_FLAG_DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
    log_info "[dry-run] Would write CLAUDE.md:"
    echo "$full_block"
    return 0
  fi

  if [ ! -f "$target" ]; then
    # New file
    echo "$full_block" > "$target"
    log_step "Created CLAUDE.md with harness map"

  elif grep -q "HARNESS:START v2" "$target"; then
    # Replace v2 block
    replace_between_markers "$target" "$full_block" "HARNESS:START v2" "HARNESS:END v2"
    log_step "Updated CLAUDE.md harness map"

  elif grep -q "HARNESS:START" "$target"; then
    # Migrate v1 → v2
    log_warn "Migrating CLAUDE.md from v1 to v2 format"
    replace_between_markers "$target" "$full_block" "HARNESS:START" "HARNESS:END"
    log_step "Migrated CLAUDE.md to v2 map format"

  else
    # Prepend to existing
    local existing="$(cat "$target")"
    echo "$full_block

$existing" > "$target"
    log_step "Prepended harness map to existing CLAUDE.md"
  fi

  # Cleanup temp file
  rm -f "$map_file"
}

replace_between_markers() {
  local file="$1"
  local new_block="$2"
  local start_pattern="$3"
  local end_pattern="$4"
  local tmp="$(mktemp)"

  # Validate markers
  local start_count="$(grep -c "$start_pattern" "$file")"
  local end_count="$(grep -c "$end_pattern" "$file")"

  if [ "$start_count" -ne 1 ] || [ "$end_count" -ne 1 ]; then
    log_error "Malformed markers in $file (found $start_count start, $end_count end)"
    return 4
  fi

  # Replace: everything before START + new block + everything after END
  awk -v start="$start_pattern" -v end="$end_pattern" -v block="$new_block" '
    BEGIN { printing=1; done=0 }
    $0 ~ start && !done { print block; printing=0; next }
    $0 ~ end && !printing { printing=1; done=1; next }
    printing { print }
  ' "$file" > "$tmp"

  mv "$tmp" "$file"
}
```

### 2. Write Zone B Templates

Zone B files are agent-managed. Toolkit writes them ONLY if they don't exist.

```bash
write_zone_b() {
  local state_dir="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/harness/state"
  local tier="$(json_get "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/harness/config.json" ".tier")"
  local tier_level="$(tier_to_level "$tier")"

  # Only standard+ tier gets Zone B
  [ "$tier_level" -lt 2 ] && return

  mkdir -p "$state_dir/plans"

  # Write only if missing — never overwrite agent-owned files
  local templates="progress.md learnings.md"
  for tmpl in $templates; do
    if [ ! -f "$state_dir/$tmpl" ]; then
      if [ "$HARNESS_FLAG_DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
        log_info "[dry-run] Would create state/$tmpl"
      else
        cp "$TOOLKIT_DIR/templates/zone-b/$tmpl" "$state_dir/$tmpl"
        log_step "Created state/$tmpl"
      fi
    else
      log_step "state/$tmpl already exists (agent-managed, skipping)"
    fi
  done

  local plan_templates="_template-feature.md _template-bugfix.md"
  for tmpl in $plan_templates; do
    if [ ! -f "$state_dir/plans/$tmpl" ]; then
      if [ "$HARNESS_FLAG_DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
        log_info "[dry-run] Would create state/plans/$tmpl"
      else
        cp "$TOOLKIT_DIR/templates/zone-b/$tmpl" "$state_dir/plans/$tmpl"
        log_step "Created state/plans/$tmpl"
      fi
    fi
  done
}
```

### 3. Write Hooks to settings.json

```bash
write_hooks() {
  local settings_file="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/settings.json"
  local config_file="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/harness/config.json"
  local hooks_dir="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/harness/hooks"

  # Ensure settings.json exists
  if [ ! -f "$settings_file" ]; then
    echo '{}' > "$settings_file"
  fi

  # Read current managed hooks from config
  local managed_hooks="$(json_get "$config_file" ".managed_hooks")"

  # Remove old harness hooks (identified by [harness] prefix in description)
  local tmp="$(mktemp)"
  jq '
    .hooks // {} |
    to_entries |
    map({
      key: .key,
      value: [.value[] | select(.description | test("^\\[harness\\]") | not)]
    }) |
    from_entries |
    {hooks: .}
  ' "$settings_file" > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || echo '{"hooks":{}}' > "$tmp"

  # Add new harness hooks
  local new_hooks='[]'

  # Pre-command hook (always)
  if [ -f "$hooks_dir/pre-command.sh" ]; then
    new_hooks="$(echo "$new_hooks" | jq '. + [{
      "event": "PreToolUse",
      "matcher": "Bash",
      "script": ".claude/harness/hooks/pre-command.sh",
      "description": "[harness] Risk classification"
    }]')"
  fi

  # Post-edit hook (if exists)
  if [ -f "$hooks_dir/post-edit.sh" ]; then
    new_hooks="$(echo "$new_hooks" | jq '. + [{
      "event": "PostToolUse",
      "matcher": "Edit",
      "script": ".claude/harness/hooks/post-edit.sh",
      "description": "[harness] Auto-format after edit"
    }]')"
  fi

  # Merge hooks into settings
  for row in $(echo "$new_hooks" | jq -r '.[] | @base64'); do
    local event="$(echo "$row" | base64 -d | jq -r '.event')"
    local hook_entry="$(echo "$row" | base64 -d | jq '{matcher, hook: .script, description}')"

    jq --arg event "$event" --argjson entry "$hook_entry" '
      .hooks[$event] = (.hooks[$event] // []) + [$entry]
    ' "$tmp" > "${tmp}.2" && mv "${tmp}.2" "$tmp"
  done

  if [ "$HARNESS_FLAG_DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
    log_info "[dry-run] Would update settings.json:"
    jq '.hooks' "$tmp"
    rm -f "$tmp"
  else
    mv "$tmp" "$settings_file"
    log_step "Updated .claude/settings.json hooks"
  fi

  # Track managed hooks in config
  json_set "$config_file" ".managed_hooks" "$new_hooks"
}
```

### 4. Write Scoped CLAUDE.md (Standard+ Tier)

```bash
write_scoped_configs() {
  local config_file="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/harness/config.json"
  local tier="$(json_get "$config_file" ".tier")"
  local tier_level="$(tier_to_level "$tier")"

  [ "$tier_level" -lt 2 ] && return

  local context_file="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/harness/project-context.json"
  local project_type="$(json_get "$context_file" ".shape.type")"

  if [ "$project_type" = "monorepo" ]; then
    # Detect app directories
    local app_dirs=""
    [ -d "$PROJECT_ROOT/apps" ] && app_dirs="$(ls -1 "$PROJECT_ROOT/apps" 2>/dev/null)"
    [ -d "$PROJECT_ROOT/packages" ] && app_dirs="$app_dirs $(ls -1 "$PROJECT_ROOT/packages" 2>/dev/null)"

    local scoped_list=""
    for dir in $app_dirs; do
      local target_dir=""
      [ -d "$PROJECT_ROOT/apps/$dir" ] && target_dir="$PROJECT_ROOT/apps/$dir"
      [ -d "$PROJECT_ROOT/packages/$dir" ] && target_dir="$PROJECT_ROOT/packages/$dir"

      if [ -n "$target_dir" ]; then
        local scoped_claude="$target_dir/CLAUDE.md"
        local relative_path="$(echo "$target_dir" | sed "s|$PROJECT_ROOT/||")"

        if ! has_markers "$scoped_claude"; then
          # Generate scoped config via LLM
          log_step "Generating scoped config for $relative_path..."
          local scoped_content="$(generate_scoped_config "$dir" "$context_file")"

          local marker_start="<!-- HARNESS:START v2 — Scoped config for $dir -->"
          local marker_end="<!-- HARNESS:END v2 -->"

          if [ "$HARNESS_FLAG_DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
            log_info "[dry-run] Would create $relative_path/CLAUDE.md"
          else
            if [ -f "$scoped_claude" ]; then
              # Prepend to existing
              local existing="$(cat "$scoped_claude")"
              echo "$marker_start
$scoped_content
$marker_end

$existing" > "$scoped_claude"
            else
              echo "$marker_start
$scoped_content
$marker_end" > "$scoped_claude"
            fi
            scoped_list="$scoped_list \"$relative_path/CLAUDE.md\""
            log_step "  Created $relative_path/CLAUDE.md"
          fi
        fi
      fi
    done

    # Track scoped configs in config.json
    if [ -n "$scoped_list" ]; then
      json_set "$config_file" ".scoped_configs" "[$scoped_list]"
    fi
  fi
}
```

---

## Full Write Orchestration

```bash
run_write() {
  local config_file="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/harness/config.json"

  # Backup before writing
  backup_current

  # Write in order
  write_claude_md           # CLAUDE.md map
  write_zone_b              # Zone B templates (if missing)
  write_hooks               # settings.json hooks
  write_scoped_configs      # Scoped CLAUDE.md files (monorepo)

  # Update config metadata
  json_set "$config_file" ".generated_at" "\"$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")\""

  log_success "Write complete"
}
```

---

## Backup Strategy

### When

Before every `run_write()` call (part of `init` and `update`).

### What

Zone A files (`rules/`, `hooks/`) + `config.json` + current `CLAUDE.md`.
Zone B files (`state/`) are **also backed up** but never overwritten by write.

### Where

`.claude/harness/backup/{unix_timestamp}/`

### Retention

Keep last 5 backups. Older ones auto-deleted.

```bash
backup_current() {
  local harness_dir="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/harness"
  local backup_dir="$harness_dir/backup/$(date +%s)"

  mkdir -p "$backup_dir"

  # Backup Zone A
  [ -d "$harness_dir/rules" ] && cp -r "$harness_dir/rules" "$backup_dir/"
  [ -d "$harness_dir/hooks" ] && cp -r "$harness_dir/hooks" "$backup_dir/"

  # Backup config
  [ -f "$harness_dir/config.json" ] && cp "$harness_dir/config.json" "$backup_dir/"

  # Backup Zone B (for safety, never overwritten)
  [ -d "$harness_dir/state" ] && cp -r "$harness_dir/state" "$backup_dir/"

  # Backup CLAUDE.md
  [ -f "$PROJECT_ROOT/CLAUDE.md" ] && cp "$PROJECT_ROOT/CLAUDE.md" "$backup_dir/"

  # Prune old backups (keep last 5)
  local count=0
  for dir in $(ls -1dt "$harness_dir/backup/"*/ 2>/dev/null); do
    count=$((count + 1))
    [ "$count" -gt 5 ] && rm -rf "$dir"
  done

  log_step "Backed up to $backup_dir"
}
```

---

## .harnessignore

Default patterns (created if not exists on first write):

```
node_modules
.git
dist
build
.next
.nuxt
__pycache__
*.pyc
vendor
target
.terraform
.claude/harness/backup
```

Toolkit never modifies this file after initial creation.

---

## Edge Cases

| Case | Handling |
|---|---|
| CLAUDE.md is read-only | Exit 4: "Cannot write to CLAUDE.md — check file permissions" |
| settings.json has user hooks | Preserve them. Only remove/update hooks with `[harness]` in description |
| v1 markers detected | Migrate to v2 — replace v1 block with v2 map |
| Malformed markers (missing END) | Abort entire write, exit 4, suggest manual fix |
| Zone B files modified by agent | Never overwrite. Skip with log message |
| Monorepo with 20+ packages | Only create scoped configs for `apps/` dirs, not `packages/` (libraries usually don't need scoped harness) |
| .claude/ directory doesn't exist | Create it (mkdir -p) |
| Disk full during write | Partial write detected → restore from backup, exit 4 |
| Concurrent writes (rare) | No locking mechanism in v2. Document: "don't run harness from multiple terminals simultaneously" |
